name: Spectrum Fist
description: Punch with a fist of clear crystal that throws a spread of colours across the target as it lands.

name: Spectrum Plate
description: Raise a plate of layered crystal that splits a blow into weaker parts before they reach the body.

name: Spectrum Pace
description: Slide over a rainbow sheen of crystal qi and cross the gap before the colours fade.

name: Spectrum Eye
description: Split the light round the user into colours and read from their shifts where bodies move.

name: Spectrum Lance
description: Throw a lance of coloured crystal light that hits and scatters the opponent's concentration.

name: Spectrum Screen
description: Hold a screen of tilted prisms that sends each ray and each blow glancing to the sides.

name: Spectrum Clearing
description: Pass the blood of a poisoned ally through a prism of crystal qi and filter the tainted colour from it.

name: Spectrum Burst
description: Burst a prism of crystal qi at the centre of a group so that cutting light flies to each body near.

name: Spectrum Beam
description: Gather the spectrum into a single white beam of crystal light that bores through armour and flesh.

name: Latticed Fist
description: Punch with a fist whose qi stands in rigid even rows so the force goes in as one piece.

name: Latticed Plate
description: Raise a flat lattice of crystal qi that passes the force of a blow evenly through its rows.

name: Latticed Stride
description: Stride across the field from node to node of the lattice with no wasted motion.

name: Latticed Shard
description: Pull a straight shard from a row of the lattice and loose it flat and fast at the foe.

name: Latticed Reading
description: Feel which nodes of the standing lattice are touched and where the toucher stands.

name: Lattice Drag
description: Hold the lattice standing through the field so that every opponent inside it moves as through thick glass.

name: Latticed Cage
description: Close the lattice in a tight cage round one opponent so that every limb meets a bar.

name: Latticed Guard
description: Draw the nearest rows of the lattice about the body to take each blow in turn.

name: Latticed Collapse
description: Let the whole lattice fall inward on the foes it has caged so that every bar snaps and cuts.

name: Latticed Spire
description: Drive one tall spire of lattice through the foe's guard with all the force of the rows behind it.

name: Bluestone Fist
description: Punch with a fist wrapped in blue-grey crystal that rings dully against the target.

name: Bluestone Shell
description: Close a shell of bluestone crystal round the arms and chest to stop a heavy swing.

name: Bluestone Hop
description: Spring from a knob of bluestone grown under the heel and land light on the far side of a gap.

name: Bluestone Lens
description: Look through a disc of blue crystal and see the heat of living bodies behind cover.

name: Bluestone Eruption
description: Open the closed bluestone round the user outward in a bloom of spikes that cuts all who are near.

name: Bluestone Cage
description: Raise bars of bluestone round one opponent until they cannot move more than a hand's breadth.

name: Bluestone Crash
description: Drop a block of bluestone on the target's guard with the full weight of the closed geode behind it.

name: Bluestone Aegis
description: Close a geode of bluestone over the user and the nearest ally and steady them against the blows.

name: Silvered Fist
description: Punch with a fist faced in silvered crystal that flashes as it lands and blinks the target.

name: Silvered Plate
description: Raise a plate of silvered crystal whose bright face dims the force of a blow.

name: Silvered Stride
description: Slide across the silvered field in a long step and leave a bright image behind.

name: Silvered Sight
description: Watch the whole mirrored field at once and see every body that moves within it.

name: Silvered Dart
description: Fling a bright dart from the mirrored field that strikes with a small hard flash.

name: Silvered Salve
description: Lay a film of clear silvered crystal over an ally's burn and watch the skin close beneath it.

name: Silvered Return
description: Catch a thrown force on the mirrored plane and send it back at the thrower at full weight.

name: Silvered Dazzle
description: Throw the whole mirrored field's light into the foes' eyes until they swing at shadows.

name: Silvered Ward
description: Hold a silvered ward before the user that grows brighter and harder with each blow.

name: Silvered Rebound
description: Hold the mirrored field steady against a long assault and return each blow with its own weight.

name: Silvered Burst
description: Burst the stored light of the mirrored field outward so every foe near is cut and blinded.

name: Windcut Slash
description: Slash across with a crystal-edged hand on a hard wind that lengthens the cut.

name: Windcut Screen
description: Fan a screen of crystal shards that the wind holds in the air before the body.

name: Windcut Dash
description: Dash forward on a fast gust and a trail of shards that mark the line crossed.

name: Windcut Sliver
description: Flick a sliver of crystal into the wind and let it carry the cut to the target.

name: Windcut Flurry
description: Whirl a flurry of crystal shards round the user on a spinning wind that cuts all who stand near.

name: Windcut Parry
description: Turn a blade aside on a crystal edge and slash the attacker's wrist in the same motion.

name: Windcut Clearing
description: Blow a wind of crystal grit across an ally's wound to scour out the fouled edges.

name: Windcut Storm
description: Gather a storm of crystal shards on the wind and loose it over the whole group of foes.

name: Windcut Lance
description: Throw a single long crystal lance on a hard wind that passes through guard and body.

name: Chiming Palm
description: Strike with a palm that rings like struck glass and carries the sound into the target.

name: Chiming Plate
description: Raise a plate of crystal that rings on impact and spreads the force of a blow into the sound.

name: Chiming Step
description: Step lightly on notes of crystal that ring once underfoot and carry the body forward.

name: Chiming Ear
description: Strike a small crystal and listen to the echoes to learn the shape of the space around.

name: Chiming Note
description: Flick a ringing note of crystal at the target that sets the teeth buzzing where it lands.

name: Chiming Calm
description: Strike a clear low note beside an ally that settles their racing thoughts.

name: Chiming Peal
description: Ring a high clear peal of crystal that scatters the opponent's attention.

name: Chiming Shield
description: Hold a ringing shell of crystal that sings softly and shrugs off blows.

name: Chiming Shatter
description: Ring a note that shatters loose crystal near the foes and sends the pieces flying.

name: Chiming Purge
description: Ring a pure note over an ally and shake the lingering taint of a curse or poison from them.

name: Chiming Resonance
description: Strike the foe's weapon until it rings to breaking and the blow carries on into the hand.

name: Chiming Veil
description: Hang a ringing veil of crystal over the nearby allies that dulls blows and steadies their nerves.
